name: Tanishka Sharma
bio: I'm a Bachelor of Health Sciences student at Queen's University. I founded Senior Buddies in 2022, in grade 9, to help reduce loneliness among both seniors and youth through intergenerational connection. I hope to pursue a future career in medicine, and in my spare time I love playing chess and figure skating.

name: Anuj Mishra
bio: Hey! I'm Anuj Mishra, a double degree student at the University of Waterloo. I joined the Senior Buddies board in 2023 and built this website. I love robotics: I was lead programmer for my VEX team, whose robot won the Durham Regional, and I've taught robotics and coding to younger students.

name: Harsh Patel
bio: Hi, my name is Harsh Patel. I went to Pine Ridge, and I'm now a nursing student at McMaster University. I aspire to become an RN in the emergency room. I speak Gujarati fluently, and I love travelling. I joined Senior Buddies to make a difference within the community.
